title: Vanderbilt BIEN Lab SOZ Resting State SEEG Classification (processed resting-state SEEG)
description: Processed resting-state stereoelectroencephalography (SEEG) recordings from patients with drug-resistant epilepsy evaluated at Vanderbilt University Medical Center. Each participant contributes five minutes of awake, eyes-closed interictal data in a bipolar montage, filtered and labeled with region-level seizure onset zone (SOZ) ground truth. The data support deep learning classification of SOZ versus non-SOZ brain regions.
methods_description: Five minutes of awake, eyes-closed resting-state SEEG were recorded per patient, at least 4 hours from electroclinical activity. Signals were converted to a bipolar montage and Butterworth filtered with MATLAB filtfilt (1-59, 61-119, 121-150 Hz). Contacts were assigned to Desikan-Killiany regions, and SOZs were defined at the region level as regions containing any contact involved in ictal onset.
